end of heading, Does ZOE work?, level 3
Yes. ZOE has been proven to improve health outcomes, as evidenced by our
. We found that ZOE members who followed our advice felt better, reporting improved mood, better sleep quality, more energy, reduced hunger, and significantly improved gut health.
link, Read more about our RCT
We also have evidence from our microbiome retesting data that members who follow ZOE advice see an improvement in their gut microbiome score. When retested, of the 476 members in our pilot,
77% of ZOE members increased their microbiome score
This research was conducted using the original ZOE App and test kit. However, our way of delivering advice through food and meal scores remains fundamentally the same.
heading, What does the ZOE test kit include?, level 3
What does the ZOE test kit include?
end of heading, What does the ZOE test kit include?, level 3
We have simplified our test kit to make it even easier for you to access our evidence-based, personalised nutrition insights.
Your ZOE test kit now includes one at-home, hygienic stool sample kit.
You simply collect a stool sample and send it back to us. We’ll then analyse your gut microbes and provide you with a score out of 1,000, giving you a granular picture of your gut health.
We’ll also ask you key health questions, and you can input blood test results, so that personalisation can begin as soon as you onboard in the ZOE App.

Thanks to the data we’ve collected, based on over 300,000 microbiome profiles, our proprietary predictive algorithm can predict your blood fat and blood glucose response without the need for additional testing.
This means you no longer need to eat cookies, take a blood sample, or wear a continuous glucose monitor.
heading, How does ZOE differ from other personalised nutrition programmes?, level 3
How does ZOE differ from other personalised nutrition programmes?
end of heading, How does ZOE differ from other personalised nutrition programmes?, level 3
ZOE is a nutrition science company leading the gut health revolution.

ZOE is scientifically rigorous in its approach, unrivalled by any company in the industry in terms of randomised controlled trials, robust scientific research, and a dedicated team of scientists and nutrition professionals looking to improve health through practical, evidence-based advice.

Our classic test kit, which dates back to our very first twins study almost eight years ago, helped us deliver over 300,000 microbiome tests. This is 300 times larger than the previous record for peer-reviewed science linking microbiome, nutrition, and health.
We now have the largest microbiome database on the planet, which allows us to deliver personalised nutrition you can’t get anywhere else.
heading, What are ZOE’s science credentials?, level 3
end of heading, What are ZOE’s science credentials?, level 3

ZOE was co-founded by Professor Tim Spector OBE, a medical doctor who worked in the NHS for many years, and Professor of Epidemiology at King’s College London. Our Chief Scientist, Sarah Berry, is an Associate Professor in the Department of Nutritional Sciences at King’s College London and her research focuses on precision nutrition, postprandial metabolism, fat and food structure.
A full list of our Scientific Advisory Board can be found

ZOE is scientifically rigorous in its approach, unrivalled by others in the industry in terms of clinical trials, robust research and a dedicated team of scientists and nutrition professionals looking to improve health through useful, evidence-based advice. We have over 30 peer-reviewed published papers on the science that has been built into the programme, and we're transparent about our science, sharing our breakthrough findings with the public, academic conferences and the scientific community through high-impact publications that undergo a peer review process. Our ZOE Science & Nutrition podcast features the world’s leading scientists who explain the latest research in an accessible way to millions of listeners.

First, thank you for taking part in the

! It's thanks to contributors like you that we've been able to help in the fight against COVID-19 and chronic diseases. ZOE was founded in 2018 with the goal of using new technologies like machine learning and microbiome sequencing to conduct nutritional science at an unprecedented scale.

Our PREDICT 1 & 2 studies, the largest nutrition studies of their kind, formed the scientific foundation of ZOE Membership. When the pandemic hit, we rapidly applied our expertise to study COVID-19 at a global scale. The
is an evolution of that work, where we continue to research the immune system and how everyday behaviours can reduce the risk of chronic diseases.

heading, I have a medical condition. Is ZOE suitable for me?, level 3
I have a medical condition. Is ZOE suitable for me?
end of heading, I have a medical condition. Is ZOE suitable for me?, level 3
ZOE does not diagnose, prevent, or treat any medical conditions or diseases. If you have any underlying health conditions, you should consult your doctor before joining ZOE.
We do not recommend the ZOE App if you have an active eating disorder. If you have a history of eating disorders, our app may be triggering, so please check with your GP or doctor before signing up.
You are not eligible to use the Gut Health Test if you have undergone an ileostomy or colostomy.

If you have gut issues (e.g., inflammatory bowel disease, Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, and/or celiac disease) or a sensitive gut (e.g., irritable bowel syndrome), then you may use the ZOE App and Gut Health Test. However, you should understand that our advice is for general wellness purposes only and is not specifically formulated for your condition. Some diet changes we recommend, such as increasing fibre and diversifying your plant intake, have been shown to trigger adverse responses in some people with a sensitive gut. While we give advice that is suitable for most people, following our advice could make your condition worse.
You are not eligible to use the Gut Health Test if you are currently undergoing chemotherapy treatment.

We may ask about your personal and family medical history, including any diagnoses of cardiovascular disease, high cholesterol, and/or high blood pressure. We may also ask if you take medication for high cholesterol, high blood fat, and/or high blood pressure. If we do, we factor this into our advice. However, you should understand that our advice is for general wellness purposes only and is not specifically designed to manage any medical condition.
While we may factor some conditions into our advice, our guidance is for general wellness and is not a substitute for medical advice or treatment.

With just one scoop a day (15g), you will get over 30 plants to help you reach the optimal amount of fibre and plant diversity for a healthier and balanced diet. Daily30 has been designed to score 100 in the ZOE App.
The ingredients in Daily30 support your gut health*, energy levels**, and daily nutrition***.

heading, What are the results from your study on Daily30?, level 3
What are the results from your study on Daily30?
end of heading, What are the results from your study on Daily30?, level 3

Our study was done as part of the development process for Daily30, and we have since made some small changes. This means the results apply to a slightly different recipe than the one we currently sell, but we think the changes we have made make it better! We will be retesting again later this year.

BIOME was a randomised controlled trial (RCT) with 399 people, with the final analysis on 349 people over 6 weeks. Participants were all healthy, 76% women, 24% men with a mean age 51 years recruited from the ZOE Health Study. The study had 3 arms: a functional control arm: consumed bread croutons (28g/day), intervention 1: consumed Daily30 (30g/day i.e. 2 scoops) and intervention 2: took a daily probiotic (1 capsule/day).
The study found that the Daily30 group saw significant change in gut microbiome composition to a healthier profile and higher score — an increase of 5 points on ZOE microbiome score in 6 weeks.
55% reported improvement in indigestion (vs. 36% in control)
35% reported improvement in constipation (vs 25% in control)
18% reported improvement in heartburn (vs 12% in control)
37% reported improvement in flatulence (vs 24% in control)
70% reported improvement in overall symptoms (vs 56% in control)
51% reported improvement in energy (vs 37% in control)
45% reported improvement in mood (happiness) (vs 30% in control)
35% reported improved sleep quality (vs 20% in control)
98.3% compliance — this is excellent for an RCT.

You will be able to move seamlessly to the latest version of the ZOE App, keeping your existing test insights and scores. Your Gut Health, Blood Sugar, and Blood Fat scores will transfer automatically, with the Gut Health score now recalculated to give more insights, displayed on a new 0–1000 scale for greater precision and clarity and now includes our brand new bug clusters, which are linked directly to certain health outcomes. The ZOE Health Study app has been deactivated as this research phase has come to an end. All involvement has helped to advance vital scientific understanding. While you can no longer log in, we're securely archiving the data and continuing to build on the insights from this work.

Is the Health Study App permanently shut down?
end of heading, Is the Health Study App permanently shut down?, level 3

Yes, the ZOE Health Study app has been permanently deactivated as this phase of the research has concluded. While the app is no longer available, the valuable data collected will continue to support scientific research.

heading, Why was the app deactivated without notice?, level 3
Why was the app deactivated without notice?
end of heading, Why was the app deactivated without notice?, level 3

The app was deactivated as part of the wrap-up of this phase of the study. Fewer than 0.3% of initial users remained active compared to 2020, and it became clear that for data integrity and user privacy reasons it was right to end the data collection now.
heading, What’s happening with the Health Study now?, level 3

The ZOE Health Study app is now permanently offline, the data has been securely archived and the studies have concluded. This won’t affect your results or any of the contributions you have already made. There are a number of research streams with King’s College London that will continue to utilise this invaluable data to progress research.

heading, Is my data still safe and secure?, level 3

end of heading, Is my data still safe and secure?, level 3

Yes, it is. Your data is protected and your privacy is our top priority. In closing the app, we are now archiving the data, which means keeping it in a more secure location in our systems. To further protect participant privacy, we have removed all of the identifiers from the dataset (e.g. name, email, exact date of birth).
heading, Will my data be deleted now that the app is gone?, level 3
Will my data be deleted now that the app is gone?

While we have closed the app, we are retaining the study data, because it still has huge potential for important scientific and health research. Your daily check-ins and commitment helped to shape one of the most impactful community science initiatives in global history and your participation has already supported dozens of peer-reviewed publications. Your data will continue to be kept in accordance with our privacy policy and participant consents. However, to protect participant privacy, in archiving the data we are removing all of the identifiers from the dataset (e.g. name, email, exact date of birth).

heading, What is ZOE’s latest valuation or share price?, level 3
What is ZOE’s latest valuation or share price?
end of heading, What is ZOE’s latest valuation or share price?, level 3
As a private company, our shares are not publicly traded on a stock exchange, and therefore, there is no continuously quoted "share price" or daily market valuation.

There are different valuation methods for private companies, given there is no publicly traded share price. One such widely accepted valuation method is to value a company at the price at which it most recently raised capital from investors.

ZOE raised capital at a share price of £0.50958 per share in the 2022 crowdfunding round. This valuation was underpinned by investment from institutional investors in ZOE’s Series B equity round. In July 2024, a new institutional investor invested $15m at the same underlying Series B valuation.

heading, When will there be an exit event where I can sell my shares, e.g., a public offering (IPO), acquisition, or other liquidity event?, level 3

As a private company, there is typically no public market for our shares. An exit event, such as a public offering (IPO) or an acquisition by another company, is a significant strategic decision that depends on various market conditions, company performance, and growth objectives. While we are continuously working to maximise shareholder value, we cannot provide specific timelines for such events. Any potential liquidity event would be communicated to our shareholders with prior notice and in accordance with our Articles of Association and relevant legal requirements. We prioritise building a sustainable and valuable business that can provide long-term returns for our investors.
heading, When will you start paying dividends?, level 3

As a growth-focused private company, our current strategy is to reinvest earnings back into the business to fuel our science, expansion, and long-term value creation. Therefore, we do not currently pay dividends. Any decision to initiate dividend payments would be a strategic one, based on sustained profitability, cash flow, and future growth opportunities, and would be communicated to shareholders in advance.
